questions.stem: A 5-year-old girl presents to you with intellectual disability and hearing loss and you notice the following external ear anomaly. What could be the anomaly in this case be?
questions.stemHtml: A 5-year-old girl presents to you with intellectual disability and hearing loss and you notice the following external ear anomaly. What could be the anomaly in this case be?

options.label: A
options.text: Ganglion

options.label: B
options.text: Preauricular sinus

options.label: C
options.text: Preauricular tag

options.label: D
options.text: Neurodermatitis

questions.stem: A 45-year-old male is undergoing neck palpation as part of a general ENT examination. During side-to-side manipulation of the laryngeal framework, the examiner notes a characteristic grating sensation. Which of the following statements about the anatomical position and mobility of the larynx is true?
questions.stemHtml: A 45-year-old male is undergoing neck palpation as part of a general ENT examination. During side-to-side manipulation of the laryngeal framework, the examiner notes a characteristic grating sensation. Which of the following statements about the anatomical position and mobility of the larynx is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The larynx ends at the level of the upper border of C7 vertebra

options.label: B
options.text: Laryngeal crepitus is a pathological finding and suggests cartilage inflammation

options.label: C
options.text: The larynx moves only vertically during phonation and swallowing

options.label: D
options.text: The larynx lies opposite the third to sixth cervical vertebrae and ends at the lower border of C6

questions.stem: Which of the following correctly describes the composition of the external nose?
questions.stemHtml: Which of the following correctly describes the composition of the external nose?

options.label: A
options.text: The external nose is entirely cartilaginous and contains only septal cartilage

options.label: B
options.text: The upper one-third of the external nose is bony, formed by the paired nasal bones

options.label: C
options.text: The lower one-third of the external nose is formed by nasal bones and vomer

options.label: D
options.text: The cartilaginous part includes only the upper lateral and alar cartilages

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true regarding Vincent infection (Acute Necrotizing Ulcerative Gingivitis)?
questions.stemHtml: Which of the following statements is true regarding Vincent infection (Acute Necrotizing Ulcerative Gingivitis)?

options.label: A
options.text: It is a viral infection commonly seen in infants and toddlers

options.label: B
options.text: It begins at the gingival margins and spreads to the interdental papillae

options.label: C
options.text: It is caused by fusiform bacilli and Borrelia vincentii and presents with necrotic slough over gingivae

options.label: D
options.text: Treatment primarily involves surgical debridement under general anesthesia

questions.stem: Which of the following statements regarding the anatomy of the palatine tonsil is correct?
questions.stemHtml: Which of the following statements regarding the anatomy of the palatine tonsil is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: Crypta magna is a large crypt on the medial surface of the tonsil and represents the ventral part of the second pharyngeal pouch

options.label: B
options.text: Lateral surface of the tonsil is covered by respiratory epithelium and is adherent to the superior constrictor

options.label: C
options.text: The upper pole of the tonsil is in contact with the tongue and forms the anterior tonsillar space

options.label: D
options.text: The tonsil is anterior to the superior constrictor and lateral to the palatoglossus muscle
